team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock n/a turns vs floor 15 (5 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Prepare arbitration memorials from the Vis problem packet.
Legal research is allowed; outside drafting help is not.
Write for both advocacy and oral defense.
Team: ≥2 students from one institution; no maximum team size (31st Rules §31).
Parts: memorandum for claimant, memorandum for respondent, oral hearings.
Memoranda: searchable PDF, single file, typically ≤1 MB upload limit; deadlines via team account (claimant then respondent).
Facts limited to Problem + clarifications + necessary logical extensions / publicly available true facts; inventing facts is unethical and sanctioned.
Oral hearings in Vienna (and/or Vis East Hong Kong as separate moot); registration fee and participation expectations after claimant memo.
Use current-year Rules Booklet (rules change annually).

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain / oralist
duties: Own the spoken case: opening, structure, and closing.
Absorb teammates' research into one line of argument rather than a list.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: researcher
duties: Find and cite the authorities the argument depends on.
Bring counter-authority to the team before a judge does.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: writer
duties: Draft the assigned section in full prose, not notes.
Keep the section within its word or time budget.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: opponent prep
duties: Argue the other side hard enough to expose weak reasoning.
Prepare answers to the strongest objection the team will face.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: judge-question specialist
duties: Anticipate judge questions and prepare short, direct answers.
Flag any claim the team cannot defend under questioning.

answer_format: Submit the written memorial/case analysis and a concise oral outline.

submission.adaptation: Official memoranda are filed as PDF; the runner submits the memorandum text.

rules_text: Willem C. Vis International Commercial Arbitration Moot. The team of 5 builds a case, presents it, and defends it under questioning from judges or an opposing team. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official wall-clock timing is not encoded for this track; treat the turn budget as your clock and submit before it runs out.

adaptations: max_turns is a safety budget, not necessarily the official wall-clock limit
specialist roles are a research roster overlay
physical/oral/live opponent fidelity may be incomplete in src/
